description.en:
TX01 is TengenX AI's wheeled, dual-arm robot for industrial embodied-intelligence applications. Its published configuration has 27 degrees of freedom, an adjustable working height of 125 to 175 cm and a four-wheel omnidirectional base. The manufacturer distinguishes a rated single-arm payload of 6 kg from a higher maximum load.

The robot combines vision-language-action and world-model approaches for perception, planning, prediction and control. TengenX describes application validation in sectors including batteries and new energy. Dual hot-swappable batteries support extended operating workflows, while actual task performance depends on training data, tooling and the production environment.
